failure_modes: A narrower or broader teacher neighborhood (C005/C006/C007) could reduce mode coverage or over-smooth competing directions, but no intact-teacher dispersion or joint-geometry evidence was read to bound that trade-off.
A temporal teacher blend (C009/C010/C011) could displace surrounding coordinates unnecessarily if the sign-changing landmark contrast is applied as a time-conditioned reward without a validated fit.
Changing pointcloud_delta_A (C001/C002/C003) would alter the curvature of the endpoint distance response without observed spatial-scale or uncertainty evidence to justify the direction.
Treating coordinate contrast features as physical interaction energies or trajectory velocities would misstate the reward semantics and could drive an unsupported edit.
rationale: Objective is affinity-primary with coordinate control only, and the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached FLOWR endpoint VJP (Eaa4bda02c9a2c3a1). The observed window is the score-clock interval [0.0,0.5] with 50 observed score times and curve support [0.0,0.49]; recorded affinities were removed and an equal score prior applies, so no absolute affinity label is available to justify a change (E0857891f4effbfe1). The inspected continuous contrast features are coordinate features of the predicted endpoint world representation, not physical interaction energies or trajectory velocities; they show multiple sign changes and strong sign conflicts, with large first/last rate z-values but small, mixed-sign whole-window z-values (E2e106e083189d150, Eace79c1f0f54c9d1, E03ad082bb04f4f9c, E894225fb605458cb, E598d52f84227fbcc, E1ba2a68ba5243c03). That pattern does not establish a monotone coordinate reward direction, so a time-conditioned rule would be descriptive rather than validated (H001), and no decoded terminal labels are supplied to connect selection enrichment to final affinity benefit (H002). The incumbent already uses pointcloud_delta_A=1.0 and teacher_neighbors=4 with fixed temperatures 0.5 and 4.0; the registered alternatives (C001-C003 delta, C005-C007 neighbor counts, C009-C011 temporal blend) are not supported by any observed scale, dispersion, or joint-geometry evidence in the delivered observations. Because the evidence does not provide a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent, retaining the incumbent is the correct affinity-first choice.
